theorem_candidate.name: Fracture-Star Normalization Lemma
theorem_candidate.statement: Every exact 3-CNF F with n variables and m clauses has a linear-size NAND3+NEQ encoding I(F) whose same-language region graph is a star of treewidth 1, cycle rank 0 and minimum vertex cover 1, while exact elimination of the NEQ leaves recovers F.

negative_control.conclusion: channel rank alone is not a hardness measure

located_bottleneck.name: NONLINEAR_QUOTIENT_CORE
located_bottleneck.definition: The residual relation after all certified bijective or Schaefer-preserving fracture leaves are eliminated.
located_bottleneck.exact_result: On the NAND3+NEQ reduction image, the nonlinear quotient core is exactly the original 3-CNF.

distance_to_p_equals_np.advance: The search location is narrowed from fracture topology to the nonlinear quotient core.
distance_to_p_equals_np.next_gate: Find a proof-carrying instance-specific decomposition or polynomial invariant inside the nonlinear quotient core that survives exact leaf elimination.

claim_boundary: C024 does not prove P=NP, P!=NP or an unrestricted lower bound.
